SELECT SUM(il.ExtendedPrice) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SIPARIS FROM Sales.Orders o

SELECT si.StockItemName, h.QuantityOnHand FROM Warehouse.StockItemHoldings h JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = h.StockItemID JOIN Warehouse.StockItemTransactions t ON t.StockItemID = h.StockItemID ORDER BY si.StockItemName
SELECT COUNT(i.ConfirmedDeliveryTime) AS ONAYSIZ_FATURA FROM Sales.Invoices i WHERE i.ConfirmedDeliveryTime IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerName) AS MUSTERI_KARTI FROM Sales.Customers c
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ALINAN_SATIR FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po ON po.PurchaseOrderID = pol.PurchaseOrderID WHERE pol.ReceivedDate IS NOT NULL
